palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Search for a command to run

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Every action can also be run from the command palette.

commands.stepBack: Back one step (2 s, a beat or a bar)
commands.stepForward: Forward one step (2 s, a beat or a bar)
commands.goToStart: Go to the start (of the loop, when on)
commands.goToEnd: Go to the end (of the loop, when on)
commands.zoomFit: Show the whole song in the timeline
commands.cycleFollow: Change how the timeline follows playback
commands.toggleReturnOnPause: Return to the starting point on pause
commands.cycleStepUnit: Change the arrows' step (2 s, beat, bar)
commands.goTo: Go to a time, bar, frame or marker
commands.historyBack: Go back to where you were before the last jump
commands.historyForward: Redo the jump you went back from
commands.downbeatHere: Start a bar on this beat
commands.toggleLoop: Turn the loop on or off
commands.loopToSection: Make a section from the loop
commands.toggleCountIn: Turn the count-in on or off
commands.toggleTrainer: Turn the speed trainer on or off
commands.toggleMarkersPanel: Show or hide the markers panel

status.noFfmpeg: ffmpeg not found: videos cannot be imported

grid.title: Bar grid
grid.help: Play and press T on every beat for a few bars, starting on the first beat of a bar. Taps snap to the attacks, and you can tap a stretch again to correct it.

loop.title: Loop
loop.help: A and B set the start and end at the playhead; Shift + drag on the timeline makes one, and its edges can be dragged.
loop.loopNeedsRange: Set a loop with A and B, or make a section or a bar grid first.

goTo.title: Go to
goTo.description: A time, a bar, a frame or a marker
goTo.placeholder: 1:23.5 · b32 · b32.3 · f740 · a marker's name
goTo.nothing: Type a time (1:23.5), a bar (b32), a frame (f740) or a marker's name.
goTo.needsGrid: To go to a bar, tap the beat with T first.

markers.title: Markers
markers.help: M adds a marker, even while playing; so does a double-click on the timeline. Keys 1–9 jump to them.
markers.jumpHint: Click to go there; double-click to rename
markers.saveFailed: The marker could not be saved
